edit.description: template_reaches_beneath answers a `**` segment after the root (root + `**/` glob), not only a leading `**/`
directory excludes under a rooted any-depth locus

summary: A directory exclude deeper than the template's segment count under a rooted `**/` locus (`docs` + `**/*.md`) refuses at load though the template reaches beneath it
acceptance: an exclude naming any directory under a rooted any-depth locus's root loads; one outside the root still refuses
tests: an exclude naming a directory deeper than the template under a rooted any depth locus loads
pins: an exclude naming a directory outside a rooted any depth locus root refuses at load
notes: kind.rs template_reaches_beneath strips only a leading `**/`; for `.claude/rules/**/*.md` the `**` is a mid segment compared one-for-one, so `components.len() < template.len()` refuses `.claude/rules/a/b`. The built-in rule locus has this shape.
